# VehicleProve

> VehicleProve is a vehicle inspection app for car rental companies, used car dealers, company fleets, leasing companies, workshops and insurers. Staff take guided photo inspections on their phones; managers see every vehicle in a web app. It is made in Malaysia by FoundryOps and works in any country.

## What it does

- Guided photo inspections: the same angles every time (every side, each corner and the odometer), each photo timestamped and fingerprinted with SHA-256.
- Check-out and check-in compared angle by angle, with an AI model flagging likely new damage (dents, scratches, cracks and more). A person confirms or dismisses each finding before it reaches a report.
- Sealed condition reports as PDF or CSV, to share with customers and insurers.
- Customer sign-off at handover: the customer signs on the phone or through a signing link, and the signature goes into the report.
- Renewal reminders for service dates, insurance and road tax, plus service history, documents and costs for each vehicle.
- A web app for the office: fleet dashboard, damage and spend charts, alerts, and each vehicle's full history.

## Who it is for

- Car rental: settle "that scratch was already there" disputes with photo evidence from check-out and check-in.
- Used car dealers: show buyers the vehicle's exact condition.
- Company fleets and delivery: every vehicle checked and every renewal on time.
- Leasing and car subscription: end-of-lease charges backed by photos.
- Insurers and assessors: photos that can be trusted.
- Individuals: inspections, service history and reminders for their own cars.

## Prices (monthly)

- Free: one vehicle on one device.
- Pro (family plan): RM39 in Malaysia, US$14.99 elsewhere; 6 vehicles on up to 6 devices.
- Enterprise: per vehicle, from RM150 (US$50) for 20 vehicles up to RM300 (US$99.90) for 40, with the whole team included. Above 40 vehicles, priced by quote.

Subscriptions are billed through the App Store or Google Play. Data is stored in Singapore and never sold.
